description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget class 'InviteFriendsFragment' that provides a UI screen for inviting friends via sharing, copying a referral code, and SMS integration. It includes visual layout, interactive elements, and methods for sharing content and sending SMS using URL launcher.

classes.name: InviteFriendsFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays UI elements allowing users to invite friends, copy referral codes, and share via SMS within a Flutter app.

methods.name: _shareApp
methods.description: Handles the sharing of the app via SMS URL scheme, attempting to open the SMS compose window prefilled with a share message.

methods.name: _sendSMS
methods.description: Handles sending an SMS with the share message using the URL launcher.
